description: This file defines a custom HttpServletRequestWrapper that caches the request body for multiple reads, providing mechanisms to access and reset the cached data.

classes.name: BodyCachingHttpServletRequestWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper for HttpServletRequest that caches the request body to allow multiple reads.

classes.name: CachedBodyServletInputStream
classes.description: A custom ServletInputStream implementation that reads from a cached ByteArrayInputStream.

methods.name: BodyCachingHttpServletRequestWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that reads and caches the request body upon initialization.

methods.name: getInputStream
methods.description: Returns a ServletInputStream that reads from the cached request body.

methods.name: getReader
methods.description: Returns a BufferedReader to read from the cached request body.

methods.name: resetStream
methods.description: Resets the inputStream to allow re-reading the cached request body.
